description: Packaging certificate gate — default-deny behavior. Both TPK packaging stages (dotnet_tpk, native_tpk) only configure a signing certificate profile when the scenario is exactly `build_succeeds`; every other scenario value (including the implicit `default` scenario when the field is omitted, or any typo/variant) leaves the SDK without a profile and the build must be rejected with the normalized `error=no_certificate_profile` line. The native suite only checks the two named scenarios (build_succeeds, no_profile); these synthetic cases prove the gate is default-deny for unrecognized/missing scenario values, so a mistyped scenario can never silently produce an unsigned package.
